claims.title: Compile one complex response into a real local chain without assuming complete scattering synthesis

quoted_fields.interface: One supplied pair y,z at one design energy, N>=2 and a real symmetric tridiagonal matrix class. Check every adjacent current factor nonzero and the global imaginary inner product exactly zero. Reconstruct and verify the full Hy=z; positivity, simultaneous responses, full self-energy/source couplings and finite-band errors are separate constraints.
quoted_fields.failure: The available native formula supports the algebraic reconstruction, not acquisition of the reported 44-site target. A Hermitian effective response can imply Im<y,z>=0 when z is genuinely its action, but no target/source mapping is acquired merely by that assertion. Small current denominators can require unbounded controls; zero-current cases need separate compatibility/rank analysis and may be nonunique or infeasible. A single-response solution does not certify arbitrary two-port scattering or continuous-band targets. The claimed five-mode optimum/stability failure, nine/ten real-mode counts, 151-point errors, local endpoint errors and Schur margins remain unacquired numerical source reports. Earlier N1030 support gaps remain open.
